blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs) continually introduce emerging entities whose interaction histories evolve from zero-shot debuts into sparse, bursty few-shot trajectories. However, current paradigms are fragmented: pattern-transfer methods lack catalog-wide event memory, whereas online memory models suffer from endpoint-role asymmetry that degrades unseen-answer ranking. Furthermore, sparse early interactions exhibit both long-range dispersion and local redundancy under skewed distribution. To address these challenges, we propose INSPIRE (Integrating Shared Patterns and Individual Evidence for Reasoning), a two-stage forecasting framework over a known catalog. In Stage I, INSPIRE learns an availability-aware shared-pattern predictor that fuses event-updated memory across the full candidate catalog while applying coordinated query- and catalog-side masking. Subsequently, Stage II freezes this predictor and optimizes a lightweight individual-evidence adapter (EA) combining textual semantic priors with correlation-weighted long-range event statistics under support- and role-balanced co-answer supervision with prior-odds debiasing and soft residual alignment. In addition, we decompose evaluation by endpoint roles and track longitudinal emerging-answer cohorts via query-micro and answer-entity macro metrics. Across four benchmarks based on the ICEWS and GDELT event datasets, INSPIRE improves Emerging MRR by 16.73%-88.83% over the strongest baselines. Relative to paired Stage I predictors, EA further increases Emerging MRR by 8.28%-32.63%, Answer-new MRR by 7.81%-41.24%, and cohort macro MRR by 9.64%-39.94%, gains attributed to semantic priors and candidate-level score competition suppressing mismatched established competitors without zero-support prior shortcuts. The official code is publicly available at https://github.com/KcAcoZhang/INSPIRE.
blocks.zh: 时空知识图(TKGs)不断引入新兴实体,其互动历史从零镜头起步演化为稀有的多镜头轨迹. 然而,目前的范式是支离破碎的:模式-传输方法缺乏全目录的事件内存,而在线内存模型则会受端点-作用不对称的困扰而退化出未见答案的排名. 此外,分散的早期相互作用很稀少,在分布偏差的情况下,还存在局部冗余现象。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议综合共享模式和个人证据以说明理由,一个双阶段预测框架,取代已知目录。 在第一阶段,INSPIRE学习了一种可用感知的共享模式预测器,该预测器将事件更新的内存贯穿整个候选目录,同时采用协调的查询和目录侧面掩码。 随后,第二阶段冻结了这个预测器,并优化了一种轻量级个人证据适配器(EA),在支持和角色平衡的共答监督下,将文字语义前缀与相关加权长距离事件统计结合,与前缀去比和软后缀相配合. 此外,我们按端点角色分解评价,并通过查询-微观和答复-实体宏观尺度跟踪纵向新兴回答组。 在基于ICEWS和GDELT事件数据集的四项基准中,INSPIRE将新兴的MRR比最强的基线提高16.73%-88.83%. 相对于配对的第一阶段预测器,EA进一步将新兴的MRR增加了8.28%-32.63%,Answer-new MRR增加了7.81%-41.24%,组群宏观MRR增加了9.64%-39.94%,归结于语义学前科和候选级别的分数竞争,抑制了没有事先零支持的已建立竞争对手. 官方代码可在https://github.com/KcAcoZhang/INSPIRE上公开查阅.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en:
Real-world relational event streams, ranging from geopolitical repositories such as ICEWS and GDELT to evolving distributed graph systems, are modeled as temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs) of timestamped quadruples ( h , r , o , t ) (h,r,o,t) ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Song et al., 2025 ; Tian et al., 2021 ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2022 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) .
Temporal extrapolation forecasts future links ( h , r , ? , t ) (h,r,?,t) from strictly past facts prior to t t by ranking candidate entities across a catalog ( Jin et al., 2020 ; Li et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) .
While recent models capture snapshot evolution, multigraph dependencies, logical rules, and histories relevant to the query ( Jin et al., 2020 ; Li et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2022 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) , continuous streams constantly introduce new actors whose histories are initially absent and accumulate sparsely ( Wang et al., 2022 ; Lee et al., 2023b ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) .
Consequently, forecasting in dynamic streams hinges on the few-shot temporal reasoning problem: predicting reliably over entities that transition from zero-shot debuts to sparse, unevenly observed trajectories.

blocks.en:
Empirical profiling across four standard benchmarks exposes a sharp structural tension, as illustrated in Figure 1 (c) (with complete statistics in the supplemental material).
At the identity level, entities first observed during the test interval constitute 13.33 % 13.33\% – 25.20 % 25.20\% of test-active actors; however, at the traffic level, queries touching a zero-support endpoint represent only 0.166 % 0.166\% – 4.54 % 4.54\% of evaluated queries.
Furthermore, emergence extends well beyond an entity’s first appearance: on ICEWS05–15, 83.32 % 83.32\% of test queries targeting test-emergent answer entities occur after debut under limited positive support, whereas on ICEWS18 70.35 % 70.35\% remain at zero support.
Hence, emerging-entity reasoning spans a continuous spectrum from zero-shot priors to sparse few-shot evidence.

To illustrate this dilemma concretely, Figure 1 (a)–(b) tracks the emerging entity Takata in ICEWS14, which is preregistered in the candidate catalog with textual metadata prior to its first recorded interaction ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) .
At its debut ( t = 310 t=310 ), Takata has zero graph history ( n o = 0 n_{o}=0 ).
Whereas querying an unseen head can transfer interaction patterns from semantically related actors, ranking Takata as the ground-truth answer to ( Newspaper ( Japan ), Make statement , ?, 310 310 ) requires it to outrank thousands of richly observed catalog competitors.
Subsequently, before the follow-up query ( Japan , Make statement , ?, 332 332 ), Takata accumulates only six sparse facts spanning t = 310 t=310 – 330 330 : two early isolated interactions ( t = 310,317 t=310,317 ), an independent statement from Jay Rockefeller ( t = 328 t=328 ), and repeated contacts from the U.S. government including two identical Demand events ( t = 323,330 t=323,330 ).
Because short sliding windows discard those earlier sparse facts while independent aggregation overcounts the repeated demands, both heuristics skew Takata ’s latent state.

blocks.en:
However, existing temporal inductive methods address only isolated ends of this continuum.
Pattern transfer models such as TransFIR ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) map unseen entities to semantic interaction clusters at debut, yet omit event-updated candidate memory across the catalog.
In contrast, online memory models such as AdaTKG ( Lee et al., 2026 ) update per-entity exponential moving average (EMA) states, yet exhibit pronounced endpoint role asymmetry: across all four benchmarks ( Table 3 ), AdaTKG improves unseen query prediction (Query-new) over TransFIR while consistently degrading unseen answer ranking (Answer-new), dropping by 57.6 % 57.6\% on GDELT ( 0.0801 → 0.0340 0.0801\to 0.0340 ).
Therefore, bridging shared patterns with individual evidence requires resolving three coupled challenges:
blocks.zh:
然而,现有的时间诱导方法只涉及这一连续体的孤立端.
TransFIR(Zhao等,2026)等模式传输模型将未见实体映射到首发时的语义交互集群,但在整个目录中省略了事件更新的候选内存.
相比之下,AdaTKG(Lee等,2026年)等在线内存模型更新了每个实体的指数移动平均值(EMA),但显示出显著的终点作用不对称:在所有四个基准(表3)中,AdaTKG改进了TransFIR的隐形查询预测(Query-new),同时持续地降低不可见的答题排名(Answer-new),在GDELT(0.0801 – 0.0340 0.0801\ to 0.0340)上下降了57.6% 57.6%。
因此,将共同模式与个人证据相衔接,需要解决三个相互关联的挑战:

blocks.en:
C1: Heterogeneous history availability and role asymmetry. Within any timestamp batch, query heads and catalog candidates span zero-support newcomers and mature actors.
Restricting memory readout to active query heads leaves competing candidates misaligned, whereas naive memory fusion causes excessive reliance on history when observations are absent.
blocks.zh:
C1:不同历史的可用性和角色不对称. 在任何时间戳的批次中,查询头和目录候选人跨出零支持的新人和成熟的行为者。
将内存读出限制在活动查询头会让相竞争的候选人错位相通,而天真的内存融合则导致在没有观察时过度依赖历史.

blocks.en:
C2: Long-range sparsity versus bursty evidence redundancy. Early interactions are simultaneously sparse across long temporal spans and correlated within short bursts.
Updating a high-capacity pattern encoder with sparse gradients risks overfitting; conversely, independent aggregation lets repetitive bursts overwhelm informative facts.
blocks.zh:
C2: 长距离痉挛与爆炸性证据冗余. 早期的相互作用同时在较长的时间段很稀少,在短时间段内相互关联。
更新高功率的编码器,其梯度很少,有过于吻合的危险;相反,独立汇总则会使信息丰富的事实被重复地覆盖。

blocks.en:
C3: Long-tail supervision dilution and micro-averaged evaluation. Since low-support queries occupy a small fraction of natural batches, standard cross-entropy is dominated by high-support entities and neglects asymmetric endpoint roles (Query-new, Answer-new, Both-new).
In addition, conventional micro averaging over queries masks systematic errors on infrequent emerging identities.
blocks.zh:
C3:长尾监督稀释和微观平均评价. 由于低支持查询占据了自然批量的一小部分,因此标准跨支持被高支持实体所主导并忽略了不对称端点角色(Query-new, Answer-new, Both-new).
此外,常规的微观平均询问掩盖了不常见的新身份的系统错误。

blocks.en:
To address the aforementioned challenges, we propose INSPIRE ( Integrating Shared Patterns and Individual Evidence for Reasoning ), a two-stage framework decoupling low-variance shared-pattern learning from lightweight posterior refinement for individual entities.
In Stage I, INSPIRE learns an availability-aware shared-pattern predictor that fuses event-updated memory across the entire candidate catalog, inclusive of non-query candidates, while applying coupled query-side and catalog-side availability masking during training ( C1 ).
Subsequently, in Stage II, we freeze the Stage I predictor to prevent sparse overfitting and train a lightweight Evidence Adaptation ( EA ) module.
Specifically, EA combines a textual semantic prior with bounded long-range evidence over the full revealed prefix, discounts bursty redundancy via a descriptor Gram matrix covariance model, and adds a strictly positively scaled translational Gaussian compatibility residual to full-catalog scores ( C2 ).
Stage II is trained offline under support-stratified and role-balanced co-answer supervision equipped with training-only prior-odds debiasing across support buckets and soft residual alignment to prevent prior shortcuts induced by balanced losses, whereas evaluation drops the training bias, keeps parameters frozen, and updates persistent states strictly after each timestamp is scored ( C3 ).
blocks.zh:
为了应对上述挑战,我们提议整合共享模式和个人证据,为各个实体提供一个两阶段框架,从轻量级后期改进中消除低变相共享模式的学习。
处于阶段 I,INSPIRE学习了一种可使用性意识共享模式预测器,将事件更新的内存贯穿整个候选目录,包括非克列考生在内,同时在训练时同时应用了查询侧和目录侧可用性掩码(C1).
随后,在第二阶段,我们冻结了第一阶段的预测器,以防止零星的过量适应,并培训一个轻量级证据适应(EA)模块。
具体地说,EA将一个文本语义在全被披露前缀之前与有界限的长距离证据结合,通过描述克拉姆矩阵共变模型来打折快冗余,并在全目录分数(C2 )中加入一个严格正比例的翻译高斯语相容性剩余分数.
第二阶段是在支助分级和作用平衡的联合回答监督下进行线下培训,配备了仅培训的先行调离支助桶和软残余调整,以防止因平衡损失而导致的先前捷径,而评价则减少训练偏差,保持参数被冻结,并严格在每次打分后更新持久性状态(C3)。

blocks.en:
Across ICEWS14, ICEWS18, ICEWS05–15, and GDELT, INSPIRE attains Emerging MRRs of 0.2264 0.2264 , 0.1877 0.1877 , 0.2587 0.2587 , and 0.1623 0.1623 , improving over the strongest baseline by 34.48 % 34.48\% , 32.15 % 32.15\% , 16.73 % 16.73\% , and 88.83 % 88.83\% .
Relative to paired Stage I predictors ( INSPIRE w/o EA ), EA further increases Emerging MRR by 8.28 % 8.28\% – 32.63 % 32.63\% , Query-new MRR by 9.29 % 9.29\% – 21.94 % 21.94\% , and cohort macro MRR by 9.64 % 9.64\% – 39.94 % 39.94\% , while also improving overall test MRR on every dataset.
Notably, EA achieves substantial calibrated gains ( + 7.81 % +7.81\% – + 41.24 % +41.24\% ) on Answer-new queries where the true answer has zero prior events.
Nevertheless, our functional decomposition resolves this apparent paradox, showing that these gains are attributed jointly to the learned semantic prior and candidate score competition, whereby correlated posterior updates demote mismatched established competitors without inflating a blanket zero-support bias.

Our contributions are threefold: (1) Availability-aware shared-pattern learning. We formulate emerging-entity reasoning across the continuum from zero-shot to few-shot reasoning and introduce catalog-wide gated memory fusion with coordinated query-side and catalog-side masking to resolve role asymmetry. (2) Correlated Bayesian evidence adaptation. We build a lightweight residual adapter over a frozen predictor combining textual priors, bounded long-range queues, and Gram matrix correlation weighting with balanced supervision. (3) Longitudinal evaluation and mechanism dissection. We evaluate endpoint roles and emerging-answer cohorts via micro and entity macro metrics on four event benchmarks, isolating how candidate competition drives zero-support gains.

Consistent problem boundary. Following the standard emerging-entity benchmark of TransFIR ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) and AdaTKG ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , we retain original timestamps split chronologically into training ( 50 % 50\% ), validation ( 20 % 20\% ), and test ( 30 % 30\% ) intervals, with candidate catalog ℰ \mathcal{E} and fixed textual vectors { x e } e ∈ ℰ \{x_{e}\}_{e\in\mathcal{E}} available prior to an entity’s first interaction ( emergence ).
At each timestamp t t , every fact ( h , r , o , t ) ∈ ℱ t (h,r,o,t)\in\mathcal{F}_{t} forms a forward tail query ( h , r , ? , t ) (h,r,?,t) (answer o o ) and an inverse head query ( o , r − 1 , ? , t ) (o,r^{-1},?,t) (answer h h ).

blocks.en:
Role asymmetry in baselines. Transductive graph, path, and static inductive baselines perform poorly on emerging entities since lookup embeddings and static structural transfer cannot track newly active actors as histories arrive.
Furthermore, Table 3 exposes a severe endpoint role trade-off between the two strongest temporal inductive baselines: relative to TransFIR ∗ , AdaTKG ∗ raises Query-new MRR across all four datasets by 12.3 % 12.3\% – 37.4 % 37.4\% , yet consistently degrades Answer-new MRR by 5.7 % 5.7\% – 14.6 % 14.6\% on the three ICEWS datasets and by 57.6 % 57.6\% on dense GDELT ( 0.0801 → 0.0340 0.0801\to 0.0340 ).
This degradation is attributed to AdaTKG updating EMA memory primarily along query heads without calibrating catalog-wide candidate competition, allowing established candidates to drift ahead of unseen answer targets.
Consequently, AdaTKG ∗ also trails TransFIR ∗ in cohort MRR macro \operatorname{MRR}_{\mathrm{macro}} on three of the four datasets (dropping 51.8 % 51.8\% on GDELT).

Two-stage gains across roles and identities. On the contrary, INSPIRE resolves the aforementioned asymmetry progressively across its two stages.
In Stage I, catalog-wide gated fusion ( GMF , FCR ) and availability masking allow INSPIRE w/o EA to surpass every baseline across all metrics in Table 2 and reverse AdaTKG’s Answer-new collapse on all four datasets, improving Answer-new MRR over AdaTKG ∗ by 17.6 % 17.6\% – 59.3 % 59.3\% on ICEWS and by 353.1 % 353.1\% on GDELT.
Subsequently, Stage II EA builds directly on this calibrated backbone, adding a further 8.28 % 8.28\% – 32.63 % 32.63\% relative Emerging MRR gain over INSPIRE w/o EA ( + 18.05 % +18.05\% on ICEWS14, + 24.33 % +24.33\% on ICEWS18, + 8.28 % +8.28\% on ICEWS05–15, and + 32.63 % +32.63\% on GDELT) to outperform the strongest baseline by 16.73 % 16.73\% – 88.83 % 88.83\% in MRR and up to 103.65 % 103.65\% in H@3.

When decomposed by role ( Table 3 ), Stage II delivers balanced improvements across both unseen endpoints rather than trading one role against the other.
Specifically, relative to INSPIRE w/o EA , Query-new MRR rises by 9.29 % 9.29\% – 21.94 % 21.94\% (achieving the top score on all three ICEWS datasets), Answer-new MRR rises by 7.81 % 7.81\% – 41.24 % 41.24\% (reaching 0.2176 0.2176 on GDELT, a 2.7 × 2.7\times improvement over TransFIR ∗ and 6.4 × 6.4\times over AdaTKG ∗ ), and Both-new MRR increases by 40.21 % 40.21\% on ICEWS14 and 68.06 % 68.06\% on ICEWS18 (on ICEWS05–15, Both-new comprises only 86 86 queries; on GDELT, only 2 2 ).

blocks.en:
Availability masking across stream regimes. Since QSM and CSM deliberately drop past entity memory during training to simulate zero-support inference, their standalone Stage I scores reflect an expected regularization trade-off that depends strongly on dataset length, catalog breadth, and density.
To illustrate, on broad ICEWS18 dominated by zero-support debuts ( 23,033 23{,}033 entities; 70.35 % 70.35\% zero-support debut share), masking prevents the fusion gate from overfitting mature actors.
Although pre- EA w/o CSM shows slightly higher standalone Answer-new, pairing each predictor with Stage II reveals that full CSM delivers a substantial cross-stage advantage, surpassing paired w/o CSM by + 13.2 % +13.2\% Emerging, + 23.6 % +23.6\% Query-new, + 31.0 % +31.0\% Both-new, and + 8.3 % +8.3\% cohort MRR macro \operatorname{MRR}_{\mathrm{macro}} , attributed to EA refining a geometry already calibrated for absent history.
Likewise, on short, sparse ICEWS14 ( 304 304 snapshots), unmasked local readout (w/o FCR+QSM+CSM ) fits the compact training graph slightly tighter prior to EA ; nevertheless, once paired with Stage II, complete INSPIRE surpasses paired w/o FCR+QSM+CSM across Emerging, Query-new, Both-new ( + 10.6 % +10.6\% ), and cohort MRR macro \operatorname{MRR}_{\mathrm{macro}} , while CSM lifts paired Both-new by + 7.2 % +7.2\% and cohort MRR macro \operatorname{MRR}_{\mathrm{macro}} by + 2.4 % +2.4\% .
On the contrary, on long-horizon ICEWS05–15 ( 3,243 3{,}243 snapshots, 83.32 % 83.32\% post-debut queries) and high-frequency GDELT ( 811 811 facts/snapshot, 0.166 % 0.166\% emerging share), established temporal dynamics dominate; consequently, lighter or disabled masking (w/o QSM+CSM ) preserves denser native patterns and achieves higher standalone and paired scores ( 0.2695 0.2695 and 0.2002 0.2002 paired Emerging MRR), consistent with validation selecting p C = 0 p_{C}=0 on GDELT.
Therefore, availability masking acts as a regularizer sensitive to stream regimes that is most impactful on shorter streams or streams with higher debut ratios.

Correlated evidence weighting ( CEW ). Comparing INSPIRE against w/o CEW reveals a fundamental accuracy–calibration trade-off driven by bursty interaction redundancy ( C2 ).
Without correlation discounting, independent aggregation ( 1.5 ​ I 1.5I ) excessively contracts posterior variance v o ′ v_{o^{\prime}} when established entities exhibit repetitive bursts, consequently inflating the variance contrast between zero-support and observed candidates.
Although this uncalibrated contrast boosts Answer-new MRR in w/o CEW on bursty ICEWS18 and GDELT, it nevertheless degrades overall test MRR on all four datasets ( 0.4305 0.4305 vs. 0.4254 0.4254 on ICEWS14, 0.3123 0.3123 vs. 0.3105 0.3105 on ICEWS18, 0.5253 0.5253 vs. 0.5213 0.5213 on ICEWS05–15, and 0.1084 0.1084 vs. 0.1055 0.1055 on GDELT) while widening nontarget residual offsets.

blocks.en: Paradigm synthesis. Therefore, RQ1 – RQ6 distill two general principles: (i) capacity–sparsity decoupling freezes a shared backbone calibrated for history availability while fitting a compact correlation-weighted residual to avoid sparse overfitting, and (ii) catalog-wide competition matters as much as newcomer encoding, since accurately calibrating established distractors enables emerging actors to surface reliably from debut through sparse growth.

blocks.en: 5. Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 相关工作

blocks.en:
Temporal history and event forecasting. Early dynamic encoders modeled continuous TKG evolution via temporal point processes (Know-Evolve ( Trivedi et al., 2017 ) ), recurrent neighborhood aggregation (RE-Net ( Jin et al., 2020 ) ), and neural differential equations (TANGO ( Han et al., 2021b ) ).
Subsequently, snapshot models refined historical reuse through copy–generation modes (CyGNet ( Zhu et al., 2021 ) ), relation-aware graph convolutions (RE-GCN ( Li et al., 2021 ) ), and local–global repetition (TiRGN ( Li et al., 2022a ) ).
Furthermore, recent works model query–candidate subgraphs (HiSMatch ( Li et al., 2022b ) ), multigranularity hypergraphs (MGESL ( Shi et al., 2024 ) ), local–global contrastive learning (LogCL ( Chen et al., 2024 ) ), concurrent and evolutionary multigraphs (LMS ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) ), and query relevance structuring (HisRES ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) ).
However, since these transductive models depend on entity lookup tables and dense histories, accuracy degrades sharply for emerging entities.
blocks.zh:
时间历史与事件预测. 早期的动态编码器通过时间点过程(Know-Evolve(Trivedi等,2017年))模拟了TKG的连续演化(RE-Net(Jin等,2020年))和神经微分方程(TANGO(Han等,2021b.)).
随后,快照模型通过复制-生成模式(CyGNet(Zhu等,2021年)),关系-认知图演化(RE-GCN(Li等,2021年)),以及地方-全球重复(TIRGN(Li等,2022年a))等改进了历史再利用.
此外,近期的作品模型查询-candidate子图(HISMatch (Li等, 2022b)),多相格率高程图(MSEL (Shi等, 2024)),局部-全球对比性学习(LogCL (Chen等, 2024)),并发和演化多程图(LMS (Zhang等, 2024)),和查询相关性结构(HisRES (Zhang等, 2025b)).
然而,由于这些转录模型依赖于实体查询表和密集的历史,对于新兴实体而言,准确性急剧下降。

blocks.en:
Structural, logical, and language model reasoning. Symbolic and structural approaches extract interpretable evidence via temporal subgraphs and logical rules (xERTE ( Han et al., 2021a ) , TLogic ( Liu et al., 2022 ) , TILP ( Xiong et al., 2023 ) ), evolutionary event chain Transformers (ECEformer ( Fang et al., 2024 ) ), and hybrid inductive–deductive–abductive hypergraph reasoning ( Tian et al., 2026 ) .
In addition, language model approaches serialize facts into time-aware or in-context prompts (PPT ( Xu et al., 2023 ) , ICL ( Lee et al., 2023a ) ), generative decoding guided by retrieved rules (GenTKG ( Liao et al., 2024 ) ), and topology-guided LLM logical learning ( Gao et al., 2026 ) .
On the contrary, INSPIRE performs full-catalog discriminative ranking that unites textual priors with correlation-adjusted statistics over long-range prefixes.

blocks.en:
Inductive transfer and adaptive entities. Static inductive methods generalize beyond fixed vocabularies via relational compositions or meta-knowledge (CompGCN ( Vashishth et al., 2020 ) , MorsE ( Chen et al., 2022 ) , InGram ( Lee et al., 2023b ) , ULTRA ( Galkin et al., 2024 ) ), whereas distributed and federated graph systems study collaborative alignment over decentralized dynamic graphs ( Islam et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ; Zheng and Cai, 2020 ; Zheng et al., 2022 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) .
In temporal settings, OntoTKGE ( Lin et al., 2026 ) transfers concept dynamics via ontologies, TransFIR ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) maps unseen entities to behavioral codebooks via textual clusters, and AdaTKG ( Lee et al., 2026 ) maintains online per-entity EMA memory.
Nevertheless, TransFIR omits catalog-wide dynamic memory and AdaTKG’s updates centered on active queries degrade Answer-new ranking ( Table 3 ); hence, INSPIRE resolves this gap in Stage I via GMF , FCR , QSM , and CSM .

Few-shot adaptation and correlated evidence. Few-shot TKG models target scarce observations through meta-learned neighbor aggregation (MetaTKGR ( Wang et al., 2022 ) ) or mutual distillation (MLEMKD ( Qian et al., 2025 ) ).
Furthermore, freezing pretrained backbones while tuning compact adapters ( Houlsby et al., 2019 ) or retrieval caches ( Zhang et al., 2022 ) supports data-efficient specialization, whereas Set Transformer ( Lee et al., 2019 ) and Bayesian Context Aggregation ( Volpp et al., 2021 ) aggregate variable-size sets via attention or independent Gaussian updates.
Accordingly, Stage II ( EA ) adapts this Bayesian updating paradigm over a frozen backbone to full-catalog TKG ranking with closed-form CEW over bounded LRE queues under debiased RBS and CSS .

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 国家 结论

blocks.en:
Forecasting links for emerging entities in TKGs requires reasoning across a skewed continuum from zero-support debuts to sparse, bursty trajectories.
To address the aforementioned challenge, we presented INSPIRE , a two-stage framework decoupling availability-aware shared patterns ( GMF , FCR , QSM , CSM ) from lightweight evidence adaptation ( EA ) with textual priors, long-range queues, Gram matrix correlation weighting, and debiased, aligned balanced supervision.
blocks.zh:
对传统知识全球网络中新兴实体的联系进行预测,需要从零支持起步到稀疏而破碎的轨迹的扭曲连续体进行推理。
为了应对上述挑战,我们提出了INSPIRE, 一个将可获取性-认识共享模式(GMF, FCR, QSM, CSM)与轻量级证据适应(EA)与文字前科,长距离排队,格拉姆矩阵相关权重,以及去偏见,一致的均衡监督等两个阶段框架.

blocks.en:
Across all four benchmarks, INSPIRE improves Emerging MRR by 16.73 % 16.73\% – 88.83 % 88.83\% over the strongest baselines, resolves adaptive memory Answer-new degradation, lifts overall test MRR on every dataset, and sustains cohort MRR macro \operatorname{MRR}_{\mathrm{macro}} gains across support growth.
Furthermore, decompositions and rank transition analyses at fixed checkpoints attribute calibrated Answer-new gains to semantic priors and candidate score competition, demoting mismatched established distractors and promoting plausible moderately ranked newcomers without zero-support shortcuts.

Finally, beyond preregistered catalogs and static names, promising future directions include open-vocabulary entity discovery under alias drift, evolving multimodal priors or priors grounded in documents, and selective forgetting adaptive to regime shifts with asynchronous inference on individual queries.
blocks.zh: 最后,除了预先登记的目录和静态名称外,未来有希望的方向包括:在别名漂移下发现开放式伏地实体、不断演变的多式联运前科或以文件为基础的前科,以及选择性地忘记适应制度转变,同时对个别查询进行同步推论。
